purpose: Revision 01 measured composition. Sizes are estimated from ratios in oblique photographs, not a survey; registration is an independent inherited block estimate.
state: Retained unobscured historic fabric in Qlocal photographs published January 2025; temporary conversion scaffolding omitted. Publication date is not a confirmed capture date.

measurements.feature: Chapel ornate corner relative to older range
measurements.inputs: qlocal-2.jpg (1920x1440): boundary of projecting left bay approximately x=800; corner bay x=1570–1850; reference is strongly oblique, so apparent horizontal pixel widths cannot be used directly as metric frontage lengths.
measurements.adopted: The ornate right subrange starts at local u≈14 m of a provisional 28.4 m frontage. Two projecting rounded bays bracket two principal arches; the second rounds the physical corner.
measurements.uncertainty: horizontal subrange boundary ±1.5 m and projection ±0.5 m; facade registration inherited, not measured

measurements.inputs: qlocal-2.jpg: first tall lower arch inner edges approximately x=1030 and 1170; crown y≈730, sill y≈940, giving height/width ≈1.5 in this oblique image. Occlusion by canopy crest and converging perspective limit a direct measurement.
measurements.adopted: 2.4 m opening width; 4.0 m sill-to-crown height, spring 1.2 m below crown (semicircular head); lower floor 4.2–8.2 m above base.
measurements.uncertainty: width ±0.4 m, floor/height ±0.6 m; compare matching viewpoints before ornament

measurements.inputs: qlocal-1.jpg and qlocal-2.jpg: clear shadowed colonnade behind forward columns, soffit aligns with curved bay top; the gallery has two broad rear windows in the Chapel photograph. Rounded bays have continuous horizontal masonry bands, divided glazing and a curved spandrel at each level.
measurements.adopted: Gallery sill 8.55 m, soffit 12.35 m, recessed rear wall 1.25 m from column line; first bay centred u=15.5 m and corner bay turns through 90 degrees. Bay radius ≈1.45 m, outward projection ≈1.1 m.
measurements.uncertainty: recess and radius ±0.4 m; projection and corner join need oblique render comparison

measurements.inputs: qlocal-1.jpg: tall lower arches below a repeated colonnade and distinct dormers above; photo perspective and cropping prevent exact count near the distant end.
measurements.adopted: six lower arched bays across 21 m return; gallery sill and soffit align with Chapel levels; rear plane inset 1.25 m; first bay at the curved street corner.
measurements.uncertainty: bay count and spacing estimated; distant return obstructed and should be revisited

measurements.inputs: qlocal-2.jpg: left range has several dark-framed grouped forms; right range has a broad pale surround with two large lights flanked by smaller dark-framed dormers. qlocal-1.jpg shows pale framed groups along return. Different camera depths preclude reading precise widths from pixels.
measurements.adopted: Chapel positions u≈3, 6.5, 10, 15.5, 21, 26 m; grouped broad pale dormer at u≈21 m; narrow dark dormers flank it. Return has one narrow and three broader groups spaced along 21 m. Apertures cut through actual host planes with exposed cheeks and window faces.
measurements.uncertainty: each width ±0.5 m, height ±0.5 m; roof junction hidden in imagery

measurements.feature: Return dormer widths after camera comparison
measurements.inputs: qlocal-1.jpg near pale dormer is approximately 245 px wide by 220 px high in an oblique view; corner-matched-prototype.png first pale dormer is approximately 95 px wide by 150 px high. Both views are perspective affected and the photos are not a survey.
measurements.adopted: Pale return dormer widths increased from 2.3–2.6 m to 3.25–3.35 m while retaining centers, distinct dark dormer, exposed cheeks and roof cuts.
measurements.uncertainty: Approximate camera alignment and foreshortening; widths remain ±0.5 m and must be checked in the updated render.
